comment: Recipe for the bridge.1-bit.app demo library. Every artist, album and track name is invented; all audio is generated (Lyria 3) and all cover art is generated (Gemini image models) — zero licensing exposure. generate.py consumes this file. Suffixes keep each album stylistically coherent across tracks.

albums.styleSuffix: ambient instrumental, soft felt piano, warm analog synth pads, spacious and peaceful, high fidelity studio recording, instrumental only, no vocals
albums.artPrompt: Album cover artwork, square format: minimalist abstract painting of pale morning light through frosted glass, soft gradients of ivory, ice blue and warm gold, subtle grain texture, calm and atmospheric. No text, no letters, no words, no typography.
